newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia dam pact signing today - Ekran.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia dam pact signing today - Ekran.

text.p: The signing ceremony for the Bakun dam construction contract will be held here on Wednesday, an Ekran Bhd official said.
The official at the company, which is the main contractor for the $5.5 billion project, said the ceremony would be held at 1730 local time (0930 GMT) at a hotel here.

The agreement was to be signed on Monday between the dam's operating company, Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp, and ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG and Brazil's Companhia Brasileria Projectos e Obras (CBPO) consortium. But the ceremony was abruptly cancelled.
Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said on Tuesday that technical hitches had delayed the signing of the contract.

Ekran's executive chairman Ting Pek Khiing was also hospitalised in Singapore for nine days last month and discharged on Saturday. The market had speculated the signing ceremony was postponed because Ting was ill.
